line.comment: * SCRIPT NAME: Joubarbe.Lib.GetRandomOffset
* DESCRIPTION: Generates a random 3D offset within XYZ bounds, optionally constrained by radial distance and distance from the ecliptic.
* Uses rejection sampling with a maximum of 30 attempts.
* Radial constraints are best-effort if no valid position is found.
* @param: all parameters in meters and should use 100m increments.
* xMin
* xMax
* yMin
* yMax
* zMin
* zMax
* minDistance
* maxDistance
* minAbsY: when non-zero, excludes positions closer than this distance to Y=0. At least one valid Y range must exist outside +/- minAbsY.
* Return: [x, y, z] offset. Sector is not appended; caller must append it when required.
* AUTHOR: DATE: 23 August 2026
* *** Validate inputs. ***
* Ensure distances are positive.
* If both radial limits are enabled but reversed, swap them.
* Work in 100-meter units to avoid integer overflow while retaining 100m resolution.
* Check whether off-ecliptic spawning is possible.
* Impossible constraint. Disable minAbsY for this call.
* RNG upper bounds are exclusive. Add 1 so the requested max value can be rolled.
* Negative off-ecliptic upper bound must also be adjusted.
* Precalculate squared radial limits.
* Generate position.
* If minAbsY is enabled, choose either above or below the ecliptic.
* Radial restriction.
* Return the last rolled position, converted from 100-m units back to meters.
* XYZ bounds are always respected.
* If minAbsY is valid and enabled, it is always respected.
* Radial bounds are best-effort after 30 attempts.
